name: 44040 · Gates Mills, OH
findings: ZIP 44040 (Gates Mills) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44040 (Gates Mills) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
